description: Empirical relief targets from NOAA ETOPO 2022 v1 ice-surface elevation, fetched as a 1-degree OPeNDAP stride response and sampled on the native 4096-cell Fibonacci mesh.

sources.tolerance_basis: Absolute Earth-like model-fit tolerance; not a statistical confidence interval.
sources.source_license: Produced by NOAA NCEI; not subject to copyright protection within the United States.
sources.source_citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. 2022: ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model.
sources.source_native_resolution: 60 arc-second global surface grid; 1-degree center-point stride response
sources.source_processing: OPeNDAP z[30:60:10770][30:60:21570], then nearest-coordinate sampling at 4096 native Fibonacci centers
